title: Suggesting a drink after work
situation: It's Friday and you text a friend to see if they want to grab a drink tonight.
tip: To make a casual plan, lead with a reaction to what they said, then pitch it with ~하자/~할래?. 한잔하자 and 콜 are how friends really lock in drinks.

turns.prompt: Agree that Friday has finally arrived and float the idea of a drink tonight.

choices.en: Right lol wanna grab a quick drink tonight?
choices.feedback: 그니까 agrees, then 한잔할래? pitches the plan — exactly how friends start this.

choices.en: Is drinking possible today? (formal)
choices.feedback: 금일/가능하십니까 is stiff business-speak. Friends say 오늘 한잔할래?

choices.en: Yeah, it's Friday.
choices.feedback: Just confirms the fact and stalls — it doesn't pitch a plan or keep things moving.

turns.en: Oh deal, sounds good lol where should we meet?

turns.prompt: Suggest meeting near the station and toss the time back to them.

choices.en: How about Gangnam Station? What time wanna meet?
choices.feedback: Concrete spot + 몇 시에 볼래? bounces it back so the plan keeps rolling.

choices.en: I'll announce the location later. (formal)
choices.feedback: 공지하겠습니다 sounds like an office memo — way too formal for a friend.

choices.en: Where should we meet?
choices.feedback: Just repeats their question instead of answering it — the plan goes nowhere.

turns.prompt: Confirm 7 and say you'll text when you arrive.

choices.en: Deal, 7! I'll text when I get there
choices.feedback: 콜 + 도착하면 톡할게 locks it in with a natural casual sign-off.

choices.en: I'm scheduled to arrive at 19:00. (formal)
choices.feedback: 19시/도착 예정입니다 reads like a train announcement, not a friend.

choices.en: Wanna grab a drink today?
choices.feedback: You already agreed — re-asking the original question makes no sense here.

title: Inviting a friend for coffee
situation: You haven't seen a friend in a while and text them to grab coffee this weekend.
tip: 오랜만 (long time) and a soft 우리 ~할까? are perfect for casual invites. React first, then ask a follow-up to nail down the details.

turns.en: Whoa it's been so long since we last saw each other

turns.prompt: Agree it's been ages and suggest meeting for coffee soon.

choices.en: I know, ugh, should we grab coffee soon?
choices.feedback: Matches their energy, then 커피 한잔할까? is the natural soft invite.

choices.en: I'd like to treat you to tea after so long. (formal)
choices.feedback: 대접하고 싶습니다 is overly polite and old-fashioned for a close friend.

choices.en: Yeah, it's been a while.
choices.feedback: Agrees but stops there — no invite, so the chat just fizzles.

turns.en: Totally down! When should we meet?

turns.prompt: Propose Saturday afternoon and check if it works for them.

choices.ko: 토요일 오후 어때? 너 시간 돼?
choices.en: How about Saturday afternoon? You free?
choices.feedback: Gives a concrete time + 너 시간 돼? keeps it collaborative and moving.

choices.en: Please confirm your schedule. (formal)
choices.feedback: 귀하/부탁드립니다 is corporate email language, not a text to a friend.

choices.en: I like coffee.
choices.feedback: Doesn't answer when to meet — it drifts off the actual plan.

turns.en: Saturday's good, but where are we meeting?

turns.prompt: Suggest a cafe near them and offer to send the location.

choices.ko: 너네 동네 카페 갈까? 위치 보내줄게
choices.en: Wanna go to a cafe in your area? I'll send the spot
choices.feedback: Picks a place + 위치 보내줄게 is exactly how friends wrap up details.

choices.en: I'll inform you separately once a venue is chosen. (formal)
choices.feedback: 별도 안내드리겠습니다 sounds like an event invite, not a casual chat.

choices.en: How about Saturday afternoon?
choices.feedback: You already settled on Saturday — repeating it stalls the plan.

turns.prompt: Say you're looking forward to it.

choices.en: Nice, can't wait, see you then!
choices.feedback: 기대된다 + a quick 그때 봐 is a warm, natural way to close. (이따 봐 would mean 'later today,' but the plan is Saturday.)

choices.en: I'll see you then. (formal)
choices.feedback: 뵙겠습니다 is honorific — too formal to end a chat with a friend.

choices.en: Should we grab coffee?
choices.feedback: The plan's already set — re-inviting just loops back awkwardly.

title: Asking a friend to work out together
situation: You want to start going to the gym and text a friend to join you so you'll actually stick with it.
tip: 같이 ~하자 and 운동 talk are super common between friends. Bouncing back 너는? and 언제부터? keeps a plan-making chat alive.

turns.ko: 요즘 운동 좀 해야 되는데 의지가 없다ㅋㅋ
turns.en: I really should work out these days but I have zero willpower lol

turns.prompt: Say same here and suggest hitting the gym together.

choices.en: Same lol wanna hit the gym together?
choices.feedback: 나도 bonds over it, then 같이 헬스 다닐래? turns it into a real plan.

choices.en: I recommend regular exercise. (formal)
choices.feedback: 권장드립니다 sounds like a health pamphlet — not how a friend talks.

choices.en: Exercise is good for your health.
choices.feedback: True but preachy — it doesn't invite them or move toward a plan.

turns.ko: 오 좋은데? 같이 하면 진짜 갈 듯ㅋㅋ
turns.en: Oh nice? I'd actually go if we did it together lol

turns.prompt: Agree it's easier together and ask when they want to start.

choices.ko: 그치 혼자는 안 가게 되잖아ㅋㅋ 언제부터 할까?
choices.en: Right, you never go alone lol when should we start?
choices.feedback: 그치 agrees, and 언제부터 할까? pushes the plan to the next step.

choices.en: The effects of partnered exercise are proven. (formal)
choices.feedback: 입증되었습니다 reads like a research paper — totally off for friends.

choices.en: Gyms are usually expensive.
choices.feedback: Changes the subject to cost and kills the momentum of the plan.

turns.en: How about starting next Monday? In the morning lol

turns.prompt: React to 'morning' and ask what time exactly.

choices.ko: 헐 아침ㅋㅋ 좋아 몇 시에 만날까?
choices.en: Whoa morning lol okay what time should we meet?
choices.feedback: A playful reaction + 몇 시에 만날까? keeps it casual and nails the detail.

choices.en: I agree to the morning workout schedule. (formal)
choices.feedback: 동의합니다 is contract language — friends just say 좋아.

choices.en: How about starting next Monday?
choices.feedback: That's literally what they just asked — echoing it stalls the chat.

turns.en: How about 7? So we can work out then head to work lol

turns.prompt: Confirm 7 and hype them up to not bail.

choices.en: Deal, 7! Let's really not skip lol
choices.feedback: 콜 locks the time and 빠지지 말자 adds friendly accountability — perfect close.

choices.ko: 결석 시 불이익이 있을 수 있습니다.
choices.en: There may be penalties for absence. (formal)
choices.feedback: 결석/불이익 is school/work jargon — bizarre between friends.

choices.en: Wanna go to the gym?
choices.feedback: You already agreed and set a time — re-asking restarts the whole thing.
